quest.title: Project Moongazer
quest.description: During your previous adventures, you have learned some very important secrets indeed. Yet the mysteries surrounding Project Moongazer and Ninnin have not yet come undone, and so, you decide to check out the final stop on this trip...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Go to the reverse side of the moon

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Let's go, then. Follow me closely, just like before.

talks.objective: Go to the reverse side of the moon

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give us a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll be waiting right here.

talks.objective: Find a way to enter the base
Find a way to enter the base

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Looks like we can head deeper into the base from here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who would've thought this base would still be operational? This is crazy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's dragon-tech for you.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: In that case, let's not disturb the fruits of their labor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? Paimon thought we could turn this place upside down now that you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Aren't you afraid that things might turn out like when we came to the moon? We almost didn't make it onto the spaceship.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Paimon completely forgot about that! Ugh. Seriously, why would a base even have a self-destruct system anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we'll have to keep a low profile, just like old times.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes. To be honest, I'd like to know what's inside too... and sneaking into my own "home" is quite... novel.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Also, now we're here, that strange sense of familiarity is only growing stronger...

talks.objective: Move deeper into the base

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Gravity seems back to normal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina! You're back! Was it you who fixed the problem just now? Talk about perfect timing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were so worried! Where did you go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. I didn't expect the depths of this base to actually lead to the moon's core. It contains an extremely high concentration of ancient moon energy.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: When I suffused this base with kuuvahki, I accidentally came into contact with it and was swept into the moon's core.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you really went there...? Paimon was starting to think this base was haunted!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Paimon's glad you're okay! We just discovered some new info about Project Moongazer. It's...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I already learned the truth at the moon's core...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I discovered who you are as well, Ninnin.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It seems that is where my mission lies. Please take me there.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Columbina? You look like you don't want her to go there..

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Ninnin... cannot survive within the moon's core.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But I must complete my mission.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, but it does not wait for you there.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Your mission isn't to be accomplished at the moon's core. Rather, it is to be found in the place where everything began.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean the Eye of Ibni-Belum?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, your mission is to activate Project Moongazer within the Eye.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That requires a data key made from the ancient moon's power. I can journey to the moon's core once again to retrieve it for you, but it will take some time.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Are you asking me... to return to the Eye and wait?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Would that be alright with you?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...No. If I can't get the key myself... I'll wait for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: If you don't come back... I won't leave.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I want to stay here... and wait for my friend to return...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I understand. Thank you, Ninnin. I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go with you, Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If you insist.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—Hang on, what about Eggie? Are we really going to leave her here all alone?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I sent a message to Maagees, and she's on her way.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: As long as she stays here, there's nothing else in this base that can harm her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's still a little worried, though. Maybe she should just stay here and keep Eggie company?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Huh? Don't you want to see what the moon's core looks like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but Eggie will get lonely here if we leave her all alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's also Lusalim's daughter, which is, well, something she only just found out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: News like that always takes some time to digest. And it's not easy to handle — what if she starts to overthink things and runs off somewhere dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Paimon's gonna stay here with her and wait for Maagees.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just make sure to come back and tell Paimon what you see, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Thank you, Paimon. My estimation of you has gone up once again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, Paimon will increase your snack allowance by one share! Now it's three for you and seven for Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, acting like a big sister... How quickly they grow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, why so surprised? Paimon did watch Eggie grow up, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, go on, go on! The sooner you go, the sooner you'll be back. Don't make us wait too long!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: #Alright. {NICKNAME}, come with me.

talks.objective: Activate the terminal

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Here's another terminal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your time to shine, Eggie!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Terminal activated. Requesting base data.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Base data acquired.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Searching for Project Moongazer... No data.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Searching for Lusalim... There we go!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I've located Lusalim's research lab. It's inside this base.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, jackpot! Let's hurry over and check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Reading the base's engineering schematics and routes... Hmm... We just need to keep going forward, and we'll get there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there any other intel?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Retrieving other data... Huh? "The Lord of Darkness Who Returned From the Sea of Stars"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's that?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The data indicates that the existence of this base... stems from the will of this "Lord of Darkness."

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Its construction also dates to a much later time than any of the other facilities we've visited. Its bottom-most levels lead to the moon's core, into which a fissure has been carved.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: An endless stream of ancient moon energy surges from the fissure — it's what powers this base.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Its purpose was to turn the moon into... a space-based weapon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—Space-based weapon? Wait, is this "Lord of Darkness"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's probably the returning dragon king, Nibelung.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the dragon king returned!? Wow, we must be pretty special to have stumbled into a place like this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: First, the Heavenly Principles arrived, then the dragon king, and now us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque, as they say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, we're gonna have to be really careful how we proceed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If something goes wrong, Columbina, you gotta protect us, okay— Huh? Hang on. Where's Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...When did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't even notice her leaving... Eggie, did you see where Columbina went?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: No, I was extracting the data from the terminal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: O—Oh no... The one person keeping us safe just disappeared! Is this place... haunted or something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Columbina wouldn't leave without saying something. There must be some reason for this.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Something related to Eggie, perhaps? No, she was reading the data on the terminal.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Could it have been...?)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Also, now we're here, that strange sense of familiarity is only growing stronger...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Columbina's disappearance might have something to do with that sense of familiarity she mentioned. What exactly is hiding inside this base?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do now!?

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: Yes. That place must hold the secrets this base conceals. We might find some clues about Columbina's disappearance there.

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: That said, our route requires us to pass through the security systems ahead — we can't afford to trigger a base-wide alarm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there a way to disable the security somehow? Let Paimon see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That route over there leads to Lusalim's lab, but we gotta find a way to switch the security off first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like we need to reach the second floor through the room on the left. That's where the security control room is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about we find a way to sneak in and check it out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like this room leads to the second floor.

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: The blueprints show that the security control rooms are on the second floor of the left and right wings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like there's been a cave-in. There's no way through.

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: The blueprints show that the security control rooms are on the second floor of the left and right wings.

choices.text: Considering the situation, we might want to fall back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can tell you're just joking to keep the mood light... Be brave, Paimon, be brave!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're gonna find Columbina! We're not leaving her behind!

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: We should head to Lusalim's lab. That place must hold the secrets this base conceals. We might find some clues about Columbina's disappearance there.

talks.objective: Try to shut off the security system up ahead
Investigate the control room on the left
Investigate the control room on the left

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? This thing looks like it still works.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe there's some info inside? Let's open it up and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the message that the creature from space sent to the dragons...?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I see. So that's how it was...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Project Moongazer was meant to send this kind of message back out into the universe?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's all there was to it, couldn't they just have used the Eye of Ibni-Belum?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did Paimon miss something? Hang on, she's gonna check again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! Whaddya know, there really is a footnote at the end!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "To my 'daughter,' Ninnin."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ninnin!? Wait... So you're Lusalim's daughter, Eggie!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, then how'd you end up like this?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I... I don't know... I don't have these memories... Why don't I have them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need to go take a look at the moon's core.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: B—But what about Columbina? We still haven't found any clues regarding her disappearance...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That might also be connected to the moon's core.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! That familiar feeling she mentioned earlier must be the core, right? Come on, let's check it out!

talks.objective: Investigate the device

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can we turn off the security system with this?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: That's right, these are the security controls.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But it seems we need to shut down both the security controls here and in the room on the right — and we need to do it in quick succession.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that means once we turn the security system off here, we've gotta hurry over to the other control room as fast as we can, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Understood.

talks.objective: Shut off both security control devices within the time limit

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
